inherits.tool_profiles: src/robotic_cutting_sim/tool_profile.py (ToolProfile.to_dict is recorded in every task receipt)

freeze_boundary: Defined before any v4 (TRIM-02-K2*, TRIM-02-K2C*, CUT-03-K2) episode (WP-11 Phase C4, 2026-10-30). Each task inherits its v1 base task's success thresholds unchanged; only the tool profile and the declared edge orientation differ from TRIM-01-R/CUT-01-R. The v1-v3 protocols, task IDs and thresholds are unchanged. No result-based threshold or task changes under this protocol; a change is a new protocol version.
units: m, kg, s, deg (declared orientation metrics), xyzw quaternions
frames: Particles sampled in WORKPIECE LOCAL; edge knots and orientation are WORKPIECE LOCAL; recorded evaluator positions are WORLD
orientation_convention: ADR 0013 metrics with target normal n_t = +z local and cutting direction c = +x local: edge orientation = R_y(blade_rake_deg) so the edge line e = +y (tau = 0, psi = 0) and the blade normal is R_y(rho) z; rho > 0 raises the blade body behind the edge. blade_rake_deg 25 reproduces the TRIM-01-R quaternion. Nonzero edge_tilt_deg/edge_skew_deg are not defined in this protocol.
scope: Kinematic material tasks for WP-11 Phase C4 (and later live use). The loader (tasks.ProfileTaskSpecV4) is opt-in: the ids are not in tasks.TASK_IDS/PROFILE_TASK_IDS, so live runtimes reject them until a live phase adds them with the physical-grasp guard.
